title: Air Force pilots report drones up to 36,000 ft

tellings.quote: Air Force pilots have been reporting drones up to 36 drones up to 36,000 ft. There's there's like 30 or 40 reports over the last couple years

plain: US Air Force pilots have reported drones flying as high as 36,000 feet, with 30 or 40 such reports over the last couple of years, according to the national security writer Marik von Rennenkampff. He says this on Jesse Michels's show in 2025, without naming a source, as a sign that unknown objects are showing up where pilots fly.
